# Shaka configuration

This repository uses the installed Shaka task skill with contract `version: 1`.
The pilot label `0.1.0.pre.1` alone does not establish feature compatibility.

| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `shaka/config.yml` | Review, merge, and branch policy, read from the trusted default branch. Live GitHub settings still govern checks and approvals. |
| `shaka/bin/` | Executable setup, test, and validation wrappers. Shaka runs the candidate checkout's copies; inspect changes before execution. |

## Two local reviewers

Use Shaka source at [da95d68](https://github.com/shakacode/shaka/commit/da95d68fd8215ae9f789a03a8c9588fb6ccf15c9)
or a newer descendant, with Ruby 3.4 or newer, for `review.local_review_count`.
Older installations must follow the [upgrade procedure](https://github.com/shakacode/shaka/blob/da95d68fd8215ae9f789a03a8c9588fb6ccf15c9/docs/migration.md)
before using this configuration. Verify support with `shaka seam check --root . --local`;
keep a failed check blocking until the installation is compatible.

The count controls local review rounds separately from hosted review jobs and
GitHub approvals. Complete both selected local reviews before proceeding.

## Check configuration edits

`shaka seam check --root . --local`

Validates the current checkout's YAML and scripts. Without `--ref`, it
grants no trusted policy authority.

## Load trusted policy

Resolve this repository's default branch to an immutable commit SHA, then:

`shaka seam check --root . --ref SHA`

A candidate PR cannot grant itself authority by changing its own policy.
